module_summary: RGMII Ethernet MAC wrapper that wires an RGMII-to-GMII PHY interface to a 1G MAC core and auto-detects link speed by counting prescaled rx_clk against gtx_clk, feeding speed and MII select back.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tdata
anchors.why: AXI-Stream transmit payload byte fed into the MAC core.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: AXI-Stream transmit valid into MAC core.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tready
anchors.why: AXI-Stream transmit ready returned by MAC core.

anchors.name: rx_axis_tdata
anchors.why: AXI-Stream received payload byte from MAC core.

anchors.name: rx_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: AXI-Stream receive valid from MAC core.

anchors.name: rgmii_rxd
anchors.why: RGMII DDR receive nibbles from PHY into PHY interface.

anchors.name: rgmii_txd
anchors.why: RGMII DDR transmit nibbles to PHY from PHY interface.

anchors.name: mac_gmii_rxd
anchors.why: Internal GMII rx byte from PHY interface to MAC.

anchors.name: mac_gmii_txd
anchors.why: Internal GMII tx byte from MAC to PHY interface.

anchors.name: mac_gmii_tx_clk_en
anchors.why: Speed-dependent transmit clock enable from PHY interface to MAC.

anchors.name: speed_reg
anchors.why: Detected link speed; drives speed port and PHY interface clock divider.

anchors.name: mii_select_reg
anchors.why: Selects MII nibble mode in MAC rx/tx based on detected speed.

anchors.name: rx_speed_count_1
anchors.why: Reference gtx_clk counter; overflow means 10M, high bits distinguish 100M/1000M.

anchors.name: rx_speed_count_2
anchors.why: Counts prescaled rx_clk edges; overflow triggers speed decision.

anchors.name: rx_prescale
anchors.why: Free-running rx_clk prescaler whose MSB is sampled for speed detection.

anchors.name: rx_prescale_sync
anchors.why: Synchronizes prescaler MSB to gtx_clk; edge enables rx_speed_count_2.

anchors.name: tx_mii_select_sync
anchors.why: MII select synchronized into tx_clk domain for MAC transmitter.

anchors.name: rx_mii_select_sync
anchors.why: MII select synchronized into rx_clk domain for MAC receiver.

groups.name: rgmii_phy_interface
groups.description: DDR I/O converting RGMII nibbles to/from internal GMII bytes.

groups.name: mac_core
groups.description: 1G MAC converting AXI-Stream to/from GMII frames.

groups.name: speed_detect
groups.description: Counts prescaled rx_clk vs gtx_clk to set speed and MII select.

groups.name: mii_select_sync
groups.description: Two-flop synchronizers carrying MII select into tx and rx clock domains.
